name: Day
about: Scrum Master 3's DAY switch: one toggle for the whole DAY group. Its state is one row of the office's database (live_status, key day); every DAY step reads it, and a DAY that is off makes their RUN say DAY is off and change nothing.

facts.said_on: DAY is on: every DAY step runs when its RUN is pressed
facts.said_off: DAY is off: every DAY step's RUN says DAY is off and changes nothing
facts.title: Day shift - Hotfix Agent

card.pitch: One switch for every DAY agent
